description: Test suite for verifying browser platform, user agent, screenshot functionality, and localhost connectivity using Playwright.

methods.name: platform
methods.description: Tests the browser's platform and type.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Retrieves and logs the user agent string.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Verifies that a screenshot can be taken and saved as 'img.png'.

methods.name: localhost
methods.description: Checks connection to localhost and logs page content.
